audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with the already-audited mirror (aatrox__swain) and the two layers disagreed with each other at index 6: phases[6].side='Swain' but win[6]='Skill'.
audit.why: Mirror findings state Level 6 and First item both read Aatrox, Two+ items stays Swain. A layer disagreement renders two different answers on the same page.
audit.corrected: win[4]/phases[4].side -> Aatrox, win[5]/phases[5].side -> Aatrox, win[6]/phases[6].side -> Swain, proposed as matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and first-item text credited Swain with the stronger spike; World Ender (120/100/80s) plus his bruiser first item beat Demonic Ascension's 120s drain at those two stages.
audit.why: World Ender grants AD, increased healing and move speed, and his healing outpaces the drain unless anti-heal is already online.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, whys[4], phases[5].why and whys[5] rewritten to give him 6 and first item, with the 6s rank-5 The Darkin Blade window named as your fight condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: Deathbringer Stance's auto-attack reset was never mentioned, and Umbral Dash (9/8/7/6/5s) was not named as his approach tool even though the E-root advice is entirely about his step-up.
audit.why: The burst tell is the auto wind-up, not the Q cast; and Swain's E must be dropped where the dash lands, not where Aatrox currently stands.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d now names Deathbringer Stance as the auto reset tell; dosFull[2].d now names Umbral Dash and its landing spot.
sources: enemyKit Aatrox P/E flags and text

audit.why: Packet flagged 'The Darkin Blade' twice as a probable wrong ability name; the kit file confirms it is Aatrox's real Q name. No rename made.

edits.before: Demonic Ascension turns his all-in into your healing — bait it, then drain. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Aatrox's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: World Ender heals him through your drain, so 6 favours him — bait the 120s ultimate out first, then answer with Demonic Ascension and anti-heal.

edits.before: Both R abilities are live — bait World Ender first, absorb two Q casts, then activate Demonic Ascension and drain; anti-heal in the inventory or the healing race is lost.
edits.after: Both ultimates are live and his is the stronger one — World Ender's healing beats your drain, so bait it out, absorb two Q casts, then drain with anti-heal already bought.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on The Darkin Blade's cooldown.
edits.after: His first item outpaces your Liandry's Torment — fight only while The Darkin Blade's 6s cooldown is down.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment makes your W-poke pressure real and forces backs; force the E-root pattern the moment it completes on The Darkin Blade's cooldown.
edits.after: Aatrox's first bruiser item out-trades your Liandry's Torment; run the E-root pattern only in the 6s window after his third Q swing lands.

edits.before: That is Aatrox's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Deathbringer Stance resets his auto — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to back off.

edits.before: Aatrox wastes The Darkin Blade — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: E where Umbral Dash lands him, not where he stands — then pull.

notes: 'The Darkin Blade' flagged twice in packet.suspectNames is a false positive — it is Aatrox's real Q name, confirmed in the kit; left unchanged. Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) grounding flag is irrelevant here (Swain has no dash) so nothing was written about it. Liandry's Torment / Rylai's / Riftmaker build text left alone — 26.15 itemisation not verifiable from local files, same as the mirror agent recorded.
